title: Council votes tonight on the downtown transit overhaul
dek: Standfirst: one or two sentences that set up the story and tell readers why it matters to them today.
content:
City council meets tonight to vote on a plan that would reshape how people move through downtown, from bus routes to bike lanes and the timing of traffic lights on the busiest streets.

Supporters say the changes would make trips faster and safer. Some business owners worry that construction could keep customers away while the work is under way.

> “Pull quote from someone in the story goes here, set large.” — [Name], [Role]

Residents can watch the meeting live on 1313 TV and follow along on 1313 Radio, where the newsroom will carry updates at the top of each hour.

## What happens next

If the plan passes, the city would publish a construction timeline and hold public information sessions in each affected neighbourhood.

This story will be updated as the vote happens.
